kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Register and Access CafeNow
kb_knowledge.text:
Instructions for accessing the CafeNow Employee Portal.

Employees need an authorized account to access CafeNow and place food orders

Steps to Access

  • Open the CafeNow Employee Portal.
  • Select Sign In.
  • Enter your authorized username and password.
  • Select Log In.
  • You will be redirected to the CafeNow homepage

First-Time Access

  • Contact your organization administrator if an account has not been provisioned.
  • Obtain authorized login credentials.
  • Sign in and verify your employee profile information.

Troubleshooting

  • Verify your username and password.
  • Check whether your account is active.
  • Contact the administrator if your account is locked.
  • Request password assistance through your organization's approved process.

Security

Do not share login credentials with other employees.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview : How to review ingredients, allergen information and nutritional details before ordering. Steps
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Add Items to Your Shopping Cart
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview : 

How to review ingredients, allergen information and nutritional details before ordering.

Steps

  • Log in and select your preferred food vendor.
  • Browse the menu and open a food item.
  • Select the required quantity and choose Add to Cart.
  • Repeat for additional items from the same vendor.
  • Open the cart to review your selection.

Managing Your Cart

  • Increase or decrease item quantities.
  • Remove unwanted items.
  • Review individual item prices and subtotal.
  • Continue browsing the vendor menu.

Before Checkout

Verify selected items, quantities, prices, vendor selection and total order amount

MVP Limitation

For the initial MVP, each order is associated with one vendor. To order from another vendor, submit a separate order.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview Step-by-step instructions for submitting a food order Steps Log in to the Employee Portal. Select
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Place a Food Order
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview

Step-by-step instructions for submitting a food order

Steps

  • Log in to the Employee Portal.
  • Select a vendor and browse its menu.
  • Add items to your cart and review quantities.
  • Proceed to checkout.
  • Select your pickup date and time.
  • Add special instructions if applicable.
  • Review the order total and select Submit Order.

.


Order Confirmation

After successful submission, a unique order number is generated, the order is saved, the vendor is notified and the order appears under My Orders

Order Statuses

  • Submitted
  • Accepted
  • Preparing
  • Ready for Pickup
  • Completed
  • Rejected
  • Cancelled

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Learn how to monitor your food order from submission to collection. Steps Log in to CafeNow
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Track Your Food Order
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Learn how to monitor your food order from submission to collection.

Steps

  • Log in to CafeNow and navigate to My Orders.
  • Select the order you want to track.
  • Review the order number, vendor, current status, and pickup time.

Order Status Definitions

  • Submitted – Your order has been successfully submitted.
  • Accepted – The vendor has accepted your order.
  • Preparing – The vendor is preparing your food.
  • Ready for Pickup – Your food is ready for collection.
  • Completed – Your order has been collected and closed.
  • Rejected – The vendor could not accept your order.
  • Cancelled – The order has been cancelled.

Notifications

CafeNow may notify employees when the vendor accepts the order, updates preparation status or marks the order ready.

Need Help?

If your order status does not change as expected, contact the vendor or CafeNow support team via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com

.

kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Select a Pickup Time
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Instructions for choosing a convenient food pickup time

Pickup scheduling helps distribute cafeteria demand and reduce congestion during scheduled breaks.

.

Steps

  • Add food items to your cart and proceed to checkout.
  • Open the pickup scheduling section.
  • Select an available pickup date and time slot.
  • Verify the selected time and submit your order.

Pickup Slot Information

Pickup slots depend on availability and vendor preparation capacity. A slot may become unavailable when its maximum booking capacity is reached.

Important

Selecting a pickup time does not mean the order is automatically ready. Wait for the Ready for Pickup notification before collecting your meal.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Instructions for requesting cancellation of a food order. Employees may need to cancel an order
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Instructions for requesting cancellation of a food order.

Employees may need to cancel an order due to a change in plans or an incorrect selection.

.

Steps

  • Log in and open My Orders.
  • Select the relevant order and review its status.
  • Select Cancel Order if cancellation is available.
  • Provide a cancellation reason and submit the request.
  • Check the updated order status.

Important

Cancellation availability depends on order status and vendor processing rules. If the order is already being prepared or marked ready, contact the vendor directly.

Refund Information

For the initial MVP, payment and refund processing may be handled outside CafeNow. Contact the administrator or vendor for assistance where applicable.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Learn how to submit feedback, complaints or application issues. Steps Log in to CafeNow and
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Submit Feedback or Report an Issue
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Learn how to submit feedback, complaints or application issues.

Steps

  • Log in to CafeNow and navigate to Feedback & Support.
  • Select a feedback category.
  • Enter a description and include the order number if applicable.
  • Submit your feedback.

Suggested Categories

  • Food quality
  • Order delay
  • Incorrect order
  • Vendor service
  • Application issue
  • Menu information
  • Other

What Happens Next?

Your feedback is recorded and made available to the authorized administrator for review.

Urgent Safety Concerns

For urgent food allergy or food safety concerns, contact the vendor directly rather than relying on a feedback submission.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Administrative instructions for managing the CafeNow application. Administrators oversee application
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Administrative instructions for managing the CafeNow application.

Administrators oversee application operations, vendor access, employee accounts, order records, and system configuration.

Vendor Management

  • Create and review vendor records.
  • Activate or deactivate vendors.
  • Assign vendor managers.
  • Verify vendor-specific access

Menu Management

  • Review menu records and item details.
  • Monitor availability.
  • Ensure prices and allergen information are maintained

Order Management

  • Monitor submitted orders.
  • Review rejected and cancelled orders.
  • Investigate delayed orders.
  • Support vendors and employees.

Pickup Slot Management

  • Configure pickup slots and maximum booking capacity.
  • Monitor bookings.
  • Disable unavailable slots.

User and Security Management

  • Provision authorized accounts.
  • Assign appropriate roles.
  • Review access permissions.
  • Maintain table and record-level security.

Reporting

  • Total orders
  • Orders by vendor
  • Pending orders
  • Orders in preparation
  • Completed orders
  • Rejected orders
  • Pickup slot utilization

Security Guidelines

Ensure employees can access only their own orders and vendors can access only their own vendor records and orders. Follow organizational access control and change management policies.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Introduction to the CafeNow Vendor Portal.

The Vendor Portal allows cafeteria vendors to manage incoming food orders, update preparation statuses, and maintain menu availability.

Vendor Responsibilities

  • Monitor incoming orders.
  • Accept or reject orders.
  • Prepare food according to order details.
  • Update preparation status and mark completed orders.
  • Maintain accurate menu information and item availability.

Getting Started

  • Open the CafeNow Vendor Portal.
  • Sign in using your authorized vendor account.
  • Access the Vendor Dashboard.
  • Review incoming orders and select an order to view its details.

.

Important

Vendor accounts must only access their own vendor's records. Do not share account credentials with other vendors.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Instructions for updating the preparation and collection status of an order. Steps Log in to
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Update Order Preparation Status
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Instructions for updating the preparation and collection status of an order.

Steps

  • Log in to the Vendor Portal and open Incoming Orders.
  • Select an accepted order.
  • When preparation begins, select Start Preparing.
  • When preparation is complete, select Mark Ready for Pickup.
  • When the employee collects the food, select Complete Order.

Status Sequence

Submitted → Accepted → Preparing → Ready for Pickup → Completed.

Notifications

When an order is marked Ready for Pickup, the system can automatically notify the employee.

Important

Only mark an order Ready for Pickup when the food is fully prepared and available for collection.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.text:
Introduction to the CafeNow Smart Cafeteria Ordering System.

CafeNow lets employees browse food vendors, explore menus, place orders, and pick up meals at scheduled pickup times. It is designed to reduce cafeteria queues and help employees make better use of their breaks.

Available Vendors

  • Pizza Store
  • Shawarma Store
  • Sandwich Store
  • Rice Bowl Store
  • Tim Hortons

Getting Started

  • Open the CafeNow Employee Portal.
  • Sign in using your authorized account.
  • Browse the available food vendors and select one.
  • Explore menu items and review descriptions, prices, ingredients and allergen information.
  • Add items to your shopping cart.
  • Select an available pickup time.
  • Submit your order.
  • Track your order until it is ready for pickup

Benefits

  • Avoid long cafeteria queues.
  • Order food before your scheduled break.
  • Browse multiple vendors in one place.
  • Review food information before ordering.
  • Select convenient pickup times.
  • Receive order status notifications.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.author: e445c235019813107f448b63de6dd79a
kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview:Instructions for adding and maintaining food items in the CafeNow menu. Menu Item Information
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Manage Menu Items and Availability
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview:Instructions for adding and maintaining food items in the CafeNow menu.

Menu Item Information

  • Item name and description
  • Price and image
  • Category
  • Ingredients and allergen information
  • Calories, protein, carbohydrates, and fat
  • Sodium and sugar
  • Availability status

Updating a Menu Item

  • Log in to the Vendor Portal and open Menu Management.
  • Select the required item.
  • Update relevant information and verify the price and description.
  • Save the changes.

Managing Availability

  • Open the menu item.
  • Change its availability to Unavailable and save.
  • When available again, update its status.

Important

Ingredient, allergen and nutrition information must be verified against actual recipes and supplier information.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Browse Food Vendors and Menus
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview

Learn how to explore participating food vendors and their menus.

CafeNow provides a centralized menu for participating cafeteria vendors

Steps

  • Log in to CafeNow.
  • Navigate to Vendors.
  • Browse the available vendor cards and select a vendor.
  • View its food categories.
  • Select a category or use search.
  • Select a food item to view its details.

Menu Information

  • Food item name and description.
  • Price and food image.
  • Calories, protein, carbohydrates and fat.
  • Sodium and sugar.
  • Ingredients and allergen information.
  • Availability status.

Important

Menu availability and prices may change. Review the latest information displayed before ordering.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview: Instructions for reviewing and accepting employee food orders Steps Log in to the Vendor Portal
kb_knowledge.short_description: How to Accept and Manage Incoming Orders
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview: Instructions for reviewing and accepting employee food orders

Steps

  • Log in to the Vendor Portal and open Incoming Orders.
  • Review new orders and select an order.
  • Review food items, quantities, and requested pickup time.
  • Select Accept Order if it can be fulfilled.
  • Select Reject Order if it cannot be fulfilled.
  • Provide a reason when rejecting an order

Order Information

  • Order number
  • Employee information
  • Ordered items and quantities
  • Special instructions
  • Pickup date and time
  • Order status

Important

Review orders promptly so employees receive timely confirmation.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.

kb_knowledge.meta_description: Overview CaféNow displays ingredient, allergen, and nutritional information to help employees make informed
kb_knowledge.text:
Overview

CaféNow displays ingredient, allergen, and nutritional information to help employees make informed food selections.

How to Review

  • Open the CaféNow Employee Portal.
  • Select a food vendor and open a food item.
  • Review ingredients and listed allergens.
  • Review calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, sodium and sugar

Common Allergens

  • Milk
  • Eggs
  • Wheat and gluten-containing ingredients
  • Peanuts and tree nuts
  • Soy
  • Sesame
  • Fish and shellfish
  • Mustard

Important Food Safety Notice

Displayed allergen information is not a guarantee that an item is free from cross-contact. Employees with food allergies must contact the vendor directly to confirm ingredients, preparation methods and cross-contact risks. Never assume an item is allergen-free simply because an allergen is not listed.

Need Help?

Contact the CafeNow support team  via Email CafeNowsupportstaff@example.com  or consult the relevant knowledge articles.
